Alex: I vote bike loop. early coffee stop? :bicyclist:
Sam: Board games for me — I can bring Codenames and snacks
Tess: I can host if it's board games, but I only have space for 6
Mira: @Jordan do you know the bonsai place's sign-up link? I couldn't find it
Jordan: https://bonsai-studio.example/workshops — they still have spots
Alex: I'm +1 on coffee stop. also can drive (I have 3 seats)
Sam: :raised_hands: snack volunteer — will bring chips + hummus
Tess: If we go plants, I can bring plant pots and a small spray bottle
Mira: Okay new plan — quick react to vote: :one: bike, :two: nursery, :three: bonsai, :four: games
Jordan: :three:
Alex: :one:
Sam: :four:
Tess: :four:
Mira: Looks like board games wins. I'll DM interested folks about time/address
calendar-bot: Event "Weekend Micro-Escape — Board Games @ Mira" created for Sunday 3:00pm
Mira: Thanks y'all — see you Sunday! :sparkles:
